mode.title: Filter mode
mode.description: smart = the LLM picks messages. prefix = only messages starting with #. both = both

windowSeconds.title: Batch window (seconds)
windowSeconds.description: How many seconds of chat to collect before filtering. Default 15 seconds

maxRespond.title: Max replies per batch
maxRespond.description: The most messages the LLM picks from one batch to reply to

maxBufferSize.title: Max messages kept per window
maxBufferSize.description: The oldest are dropped after this, so the context stays short when chat floods in

prefixChar.title: Call-out prefix
prefixChar.description: Messages with this prefix get an immediate reply and skip the filter

checkInterval.title: Chat fetch interval (ms)
checkInterval.description: How many milliseconds between chat fetches from the Bilibili API
